subject: Request: one-time scaling credits + extended POC window for BrightBridge
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time scaling credits + extended POC window for BrightBridge

Team — looping you in for a quick exec ask on BrightBridge. Short version: they’ve been running a PLG sandbox for 4 weeks and consumption is spiking; their integration tests and load testing will push them past our standard free sandbox cap in ~72 hours. They’re a strategic mid-market prospect (ML infra + healthcare analytics vertical) and the AE thinks there’s a >65% chance of conversion if we avoid an artificial outage during their scale test.

Why we should consider an exception:
- They showed product-market fit in two pilot scenarios and started integration with a customer dataset yesterday (PII-handled via their side).
- Current usage profile suggests a sustained spike for 7–10 days during sim tests; without extra runway the sandbox will throttle and they’ll pause evaluation.
- Sales is proposing a mutual action plan: if we grant a one-time 150k token credit + extend the sandbox 10 days, BrightBridge will sign a 12-month committed Dedicated pilot worth $180k ARR contingent on successful QoE.

What I’m asking: exec blessing for a one-time, non-standard sandbox uplift (150k tokens) and a 10-day POC extension. We should include an explicit clause: credits expire if contract not signed within 30 days of the POC end. We’ll also require a PO or signed LOI from procurement.

Attachments: usage snapshot and proposed memorandum of partnership (proposed-mop.pdf).

Appreciate quick eyes — Jordan/Aditya/Laura, can you weigh the operational, commercial, and legal risk? If yes, I’ll authorize enablement once we have a PO.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0198

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Jun 2028 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time scaling credits + extended POC window for BrightBridge

Thanks Vanessa — I’m broadly supportive of helping remove friction for a high-intent mid-market buyer, but need two confirmations before I sign off:
1) Commercial: Is the AE comfortable with the 12-month commit at $180k ARR as the minimum conversion case? I want a clear acceptance milestone (e.g., ML pipeline in prod, or signed SOW) that triggers credit forgiveness.
2) Finance/Risk: Laura — can legal/finance provide a short redline that protects Redwood (credit clawback if they use credits and then disappear) and ensures we capture an LOI or PO before we enable the uplift?

If both are clean, I’ll approve the uplift as a one-off under the discretionary sales ops fund. Please keep the credit expiration clause (30 days) and require PO/LOI.

— Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Jun 2028 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time scaling credits + extended POC window for BrightBridge

Vanessa / Aditya — legal ok with a one-time uplift provided we attach two protections to the temporary uplift:

- Signed LOI/PO required before credits are unlocked. LOI must reference the draft SOW and expected conversion terms (12-month minimum).
- Credit recapture clause: credits are treated as a prepayment against future invoices and are refundable/recoverable if no qualifying contract is executed within 30 days of POC close. If they sign but later renege, we offset outstanding invoices or invoice for used credits.

I’ve prepared a very short addendum (one page) that does this and keeps the uplift operationally light. I’ll attach as part of the DocuSign packet — Jordan/Vanessa, confirm the signature path (procurement then Elena) and I’ll route.

-Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightbridge.ai>, procurement@brightbridge.ai
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Jun 2028 14:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-time scaling credits + extended POC window for BrightBridge

Elena — great to speak earlier. Following up with the play we discussed: Redwood can approve a one-time 150k token uplift and a 10-day POC extension, contingent on the LOI/PO and the short legal addendum Laura drafted (attached). Please review the term in bullet form below and confirm by replying to this thread or by signing the DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/BB-POC-2028

Summary of temporary uplift (BrightBridge POC):
- Uplift: 150,000 tokens applied to BrightBridge sandbox (one-time).
- Window: 10 additional calendar days beyond current sandbox end date.
- Activation: Credits unlocked only after BrightBridge returns signed LOI/PO referencing the draft SOW within 72 hours of signing.
- Expiry / Recapture: Credits expire and are recoverable if a qualifying contract is not executed within 30 days of the end of the extended POC.
- Commitment: Sales expects conversion to a 12-month Dedicated pilot at ~$180k ARR; this is the qualifying conversion milestone.

Attachments: proposed-mop.pdf (business terms) and brightbridge_poc_usage_snapshot.csv (consumption).

If procurement needs any tweaks to the LOI language, loop Laura and I and we’ll expedite. Once Elena confirms, Jordan and I will flip the enablement toggle and coordinate brief onboarding with Platform Ops so the test can run uninterrupted.

Thanks — Vanessa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0198
